  "implementation": "Install Button if missing (`npx shadcn add @skrewww/button`); do not invent a Dialog install command. DialogFooter: Button variant=\"secondary\" Cancel and Button variant=\"danger\" confirm. Preserve rounded/glass from layout. Optional initialFocusRef/finalFocusRef if a specific focus target is needed."
